page_title: TOR 2-1 VER | Torino v Verona 11/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+2' The referee points to the corner flag and Verona will take a corner.
90+1' A corner kick by Verona is thwarted by the well prepared Alberto Paleari (Torino).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) takes a short corner kick.
84' Substitution. Cristiano Biraghi (Torino) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Rafael Obrador walks off.
84' Roberto D'Aversa is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Enzo Ebosse (Torino) suffers an injury and Guillermo Maripan comes on.
82' Paolo Sammarco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amin Sarr (Verona) replacing Rafik Belghali.
81' A substitution has been made. Martin Frese goes off and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes on.
81' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
80' Verona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
76' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
75' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis will be replaced by Matteo Prati (Torino).
75' That's the end of the game for Che Adams, who is replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).
73' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a long ball in, but Alberto Paleari comfortably gathers the ball.

71' Gift Orban (Verona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross low towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Alberto Paleari makes a comfortable save.
70' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
68' Paolo Sammarco has decided to substitute Antoine Bernede and he is replaced by Domagoj Bradaric (Verona).
67' Here comes a substitution. Luca Marianucci (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Saul Coco.
65' A yellow card for a tackle by Daniel Oyegoke (Verona). Kevin Bonacina doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
65' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
64' Wow, what an escape. Kieron Bowie (Verona) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
64' Total attempts – 12:9.
60' Here is a change. Abdou Harroui is going off and Paolo Sammarco gives the last tactical orders to Gift Orban (Verona).
60' Substitution. Nicolas Valentini (Verona) on for Andrias Edmundsson.
58' The goal by Torino is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
57' Wait! Referee Kevin Bonacina has indicated he is going to review the Torino goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
56' Che Adams (Torino) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
55' Rafael Obrador (Torino) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

50' 2 - 1 Goal! Rafael Obrador plays in Cesare Casadei (Torino), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 2:1.

49' Kieron Bowie (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Kevin Bonacina blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Torino have a free kick.

48' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
46' Today's referee Kevin Bonacina rightly decides to book Martin Frese (Verona) for his harsh tackle.
46' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+2' The ball spins to Che Adams (Torino) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

41' Antoine Bernede (Verona) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
38' 1 - 1 Amazing piece of skill! Kieron Bowie (Verona) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball into the bottom right corner. What a finish that is!
36' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alberto Paleari is quickest to intercept the ball.
33' Che Adams (Torino) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
28' Kieron Bowie (Verona) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Torino win a free kick.
26' Kevin Bonacina shows a yellow card to Andrias Edmundsson (Verona) for a tough tackle.
25' Rafik Belghali (Verona) sends a long ball forward to Kieron Bowie, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
25' Torino control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
25' Kevin Bonacina shows the yellow card to Ardian Ismajli (Torino) for a heavy challenge.
23' Victor Nelsson (Verona) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
22' Torino take a short corner kick.
21' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and signals a foul after Victor Nelsson (Verona) brought his opponent down. Torino will take a free kick near the side line.
18' Alberto Paleari leaps to intercept the corner kick from Martin Frese (Verona).
17' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
15' A pass lands at the feet of Che Adams (Torino) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
13' Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) sends a long ball in, but Alberto Paleari comfortably gathers the ball.
11' Roberto Gagliardini (Verona) finds his way to the ball inside the box from the free kick, but his header only hits the crossbar.
9' Enzo Ebosse (Torino) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Marcus Pedersen provides Giovanni Simeone (Torino) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
5' Rafik Belghali (Verona) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
3' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Verona will kick the game off.
Kevin Bonacina is the one to supervise the game today.
